order-confirmation.label: Order Confirmation
order-confirmation.description: Sent immediately after a customer places an order.
order-confirmation.subject: Your order {{ order.name }} is confirmed — {{ shop.name }}

abandoned-checkout.label: Abandoned Checkout
abandoned-checkout.description: Sent when a customer leaves without completing their purchase.
abandoned-checkout.subject: You left something in your cart — {{ shop.name }}

shipping-confirmation.label: Shipping Confirmation
shipping-confirmation.description: Sent when an order is fulfilled and shipped.
shipping-confirmation.subject: Your order {{ order.name }} has shipped — {{ shop.name }}

out-for-delivery.label: Out for Delivery
out-for-delivery.description: Sent when the carrier marks the shipment as out for delivery.
out-for-delivery.subject: Your order {{ order.name }} is out for delivery today — {{ shop.name }}

order-delivered.label: Order Delivered
order-delivered.description: Sent when the carrier confirms delivery.
order-delivered.subject: Your order {{ order.name }} has been delivered — {{ shop.name }}

refund-notification.label: Refund Notification
refund-notification.description: Sent when a full or partial refund is issued.
refund-notification.subject: Refund processed for order {{ order.name }} — {{ shop.name }}

account-welcome.label: Customer Account Welcome
account-welcome.description: Sent when a new customer account is created.
account-welcome.subject: Welcome to {{ shop.name }}, {{ customer.first_name }}!

password-reset.label: Password Reset
password-reset.description: Sent when a customer requests a password reset.
password-reset.subject: Reset your {{ shop.name }} account password
